verdict.rationale: Asaas documents API-created subaccounts so each seller gets an individual account that runs its own financial operations, which covers onboarding. It also lists split as a platform feature with Split Settings on payment creation, and supports transfers/TED for moving money out. Together these first-party features cover the core marketplace onboard–split–payout flow, but the evidence on each piece is thin. Missing for 10: detailed split mechanics (percentage/fixed, per-wallet routing), explicit documentation of seller payout/withdrawal flows and seller KYC onboarding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
